pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The factory starts with an issue that has no commands, posts, branch or pull request, and every step is a Next step.

pins.name: NoDoubleAnswer
pins.says: No command, retry, build or merge is ever answered by more than one factory post.

pins.name: OnlyHolderActs
pins.says: No watcher ever takes an effect on GitHub while it doesn't hold the repository's lease.

pins.name: NoRunTwice
pins.says: No agent run is ever started twice for one draft or build.

pins.name: OnePullRequest
pins.says: Each build opens at most one pull request, even once that pull request is closed or merged.

pins.name: OneOpenPullRequest
pins.says: At most one of the ratified proposal's pull requests is open at a time: a retry's build opens its own only after the draft it replaces is closed.

pins.name: RetiredOnlyByRecord
pins.says: The factory closes a draft only once a record every watcher can read says a retry replaces it.

pins.name: NoReplacingMerged
pins.says: A retry whose draft someone merged starts no build and opens no pull request.

pins.name: OwnGate
pins.says: CI's gate counts only on the latest build's own pull request: it never stands passed before that pull request opens.

pins.name: OwnRun
pins.says: The latest build's result comes only from its own agent run, never from an earlier build's.

pins.name: OneMerge
pins.says: The pull request is merged at most once.

pins.name: MergeOnlyAfterGate
pins.says: The factory merges only after CI's gate passes on a pull request GitHub can merge.

pins.name: ReadiedOnlyWhenWatched
pins.says: The factory marks a failed draft ready only once it has answered a writer's retry that watches it again.

pins.name: ReadiedOnlyAfterGate
pins.says: The factory marks a draft ready only once CI's gate has passed on it and the factory can merge it: GitHub can merge it, and it doesn't change the trusted base.

pins.name: FollowSnapshotsKept
pins.says: Every accepted Workflow snapshot is durably retained with its original contents across effects, watchers and crashes.

pins.name: FollowOnePR
pins.says: A follow-up opens at most one PR for its source ratified-plan obligation and keeps the same branch and PR across attempts, closure and resumption.

pins.name: FollowOperationOnce
pins.says: Every recorded follow-up draft, creation, repair, publication, reopening and merge operation is dispatched at most once, including after a stopped operation or lost response.

pins.name: FollowOneMerge
pins.says: The follow-up PR is merged at most once across factory actions, external merges and recovery.

pins.name: FollowWriterRequired
pins.says: Closed or exhausted follow-up work resumes only after consuming an explicit writer request, and reopening uses the same PR under that authorization.

pins.name: FollowRenewalWaits
pins.says: A retry or resume received during an unresolved repair waits until that operation and its publication have been reconciled before the request is consumed.

pins.name: FollowSnapshotsBeforeEffects
pins.says: Every follow-up effect is tied to its own recorded intent and an already durable accepted Workflow snapshot bearing the stable source, branch and PR identity.

pins.name: FollowEffectLedger
pins.says: Pending and completed follow-up effects retain distinct operation identities, and an operation settles only after all its recorded effects are reconciled.

pins.name: FollowResultsCurrent
pins.says: An accepted follow-up result belongs to the current operation and a successful result belongs to the revision it acts on.

pins.name: FollowCurrentRevision
pins.says: Follow-up publication and merge effects use the current lease fence and head revision, and a merge uses CI and mergeability observations for that same revision.

pins.name: FollowAllowance
pins.says: Each Workflow-authorized repair consumes exactly one of the two allowances for its renewal period, and consuming a writer request once renews the allowance to two.

pins.name: FollowFailurePreserved
pins.says: Recovery preserves the actual failed, stopped or no-change result of a repair instead of changing its failure cause or refunding its recorded usage.

pins.name: FollowMergeConfirmed
pins.says: Merge authorization alone cannot establish a merge, while confirmed results and external observations settle through outcome handling without dispatching another merge for an externally merged PR.

pins.name: FollowAnswersOnce
pins.says: A follow-up writer retry or resume receives at most one answer across watchers and crashes.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every part of the state always has the expected kind of value.

pins.name: Merged
pins.says: The pull request can be merged and the merge reported.

pins.name: ReportedUnmergeable
pins.says: A pull request whose gate passed can be reported as one that can't merge.

pins.name: StoppedRunReported
pins.says: A build whose agent run stopped partway can be reported as stopped.

pins.name: RetryBuilt
pins.says: A writer's retry of a stopped build can open the pull request and be answered.

pins.name: RecoveredAfterCrashes
pins.says: After the most crashes allowed, the factory can still get the pull request merged and reported.

pins.name: Replaced
pins.says: A writer's retry can replace a failed draft: the factory closes the draft, and the retry's build opens a new pull request and is answered.

pins.name: ReplacedAndMerged
pins.says: The pull request that replaced a failed draft can be merged and the merge reported.

pins.name: FailedAgain
pins.says: A retry's build can leave a failed draft too, which a writer can retry in turn.

pins.name: StoppedAfterRetiring
pins.says: A retry's build can stop after the draft it replaces was closed, and be reported as stopped, keeping the record the next retry builds on.

pins.name: MergedDraftKept
pins.says: A retry whose draft someone merged is answered without replacing it.

pins.name: ClosedDraftNoted
pins.says: A retry whose draft someone else closed before its record was stored is answered without a build.

pins.name: WatchedBeforeGate
pins.says: A writer's retry can watch a failed draft again before CI's gate passes on it, and is answered while the factory waits for the gate.

pins.name: WatchedAndMerged
pins.says: A writer's retry can watch a failed draft again, and the factory marks it ready and merges it once CI's gate passes.

pins.name: WatchedButUnmergeable
pins.says: A watched draft the factory can't merge, such as one that changes the trusted base, is reported without being marked ready.

pins.name: CommandsAnswered
pins.says: Every command and retry a writer gives is eventually answered by a factory post.

pins.name: BuildsAnswered
pins.says: Every build a ratification or a retry starts is eventually answered: by its pull request, or by a report that it stopped.

pins.name: GatedPullRequestsSettled
pins.says: Once CI's gate passes on a pull request that isn't a failed draft, the factory eventually merges it or reports it: as one that can't merge, or as merged or closed by someone else.

pins.name: WatchedDraftsSettled
pins.says: Once CI's gate passes on a failed draft a writer's retry watches again, the factory eventually merges it or reports it: as one that can't merge, or as merged or closed by someone else.

pins.name: FairAcquire
pins.says: A running watcher eventually takes a lease that nobody holds.

pins.name: FairExpire
pins.says: A lease whose holder has crashed eventually runs out.

pins.name: FairAct
pins.says: A watcher holding the lease eventually takes the next effect that's due.

pins.name: FairFinishRun
pins.says: An agent run held by the lease's holder eventually finishes and is recorded.

pins.name: FairDropRun
pins.says: A watcher that has lost the lease eventually drops the agent run it was in.

pins.name: PostWithoutLooking
pins.says: A watcher posts its answer without looking for an answer already there.

pins.name: PostWithoutLease
pins.says: A watcher that woke after its lease ran out posts without checking the lease.

pins.name: RerunStoppedRun
pins.says: A watcher that finds an agent run that stopped partway starts it again.

pins.name: OpenWithoutLookingClosed
pins.says: A watcher finds no open pull request for the latest build, misses the one it opened that was since closed or merged, and opens another.

pins.name: OpenBeforeRetiring
pins.says: A retry's build opens its pull request while the draft it replaces is still open.

pins.name: RetireWithoutRecord
pins.says: The factory closes the draft before storing the retry's record, so after a crash its own close looks like someone else's.

pins.name: ReplaceMergedDraft
pins.says: A retry whose draft someone merged builds again anyway.

pins.name: KeepGateAcrossRetry
pins.says: A writer's retry keeps CI's result from the draft it replaces.

pins.name: FinishStaleRun
pins.says: A watcher whose agent run a retry made stale records it as the latest build's.

pins.name: CloseWithoutLease
pins.says: A watcher that woke after its lease ran out closes the draft without checking the lease.

pins.name: MarkReadyWithoutWatch
pins.says: The factory marks a failed draft ready when no writer's retry watches it again.

pins.name: MarkReadyBeforeGate
pins.says: The factory marks a watched draft ready before CI's gate passes on it.

pins.name: MarkUnmergeableReady
pins.says: The factory marks ready a watched draft it can't merge, such as one that changes the trusted base.

pins.name: AnswerWatchWithoutLooking
pins.says: A watcher answers a retry that watches a failed draft again without looking for an answer already there.

pins.name: AutomaticDraftAndCreateRecovery
pins.says: Failed follow-up drafting and creation can each recover automatically through fresh recorded attempts and open the single PR.

pins.name: RepairAfterCIFailure
pins.says: A CI failure can lead to a charged repair that publishes a new revision on the same PR.

pins.name: ExhaustedThenRenewed
pins.says: After two repairs are exhausted, a writer request can renew the allowance and permit another repair on the same PR.

pins.name: ClosedFollowupResumed
pins.says: A writer request can resume closed follow-up work by reopening its existing PR.

pins.name: LostCreationAdoptsClosed
pins.says: A lost creation response can adopt the existing PR after a person closes it.

pins.name: LostCreationAdoptsMerged
pins.says: A lost creation response can adopt and settle the existing PR after a person merges it.

pins.name: LostRepairPublicationRecovered
pins.says: A lost repair publication response can be reconciled without publishing or charging the repair again.

pins.name: LostMergeResponseRecovered
pins.says: After a crash, a lost merge response can be reconciled as success from the actual remote result.

pins.name: UnknownMergeRecorded
pins.says: Recovery can record an unknown merge outcome while leaving the work unsettled.

pins.name: MergeRefusalReconciled
pins.says: Recovery can reconcile and report a definitive merge refusal without claiming a merge.

pins.name: ExternalMergeObserved
pins.says: An externally merged follow-up can settle from observation with no fabricated CI result or factory merge dispatch.

pins.name: PendingRenewalReconciled
pins.says: A request arriving during a repair can be answered once after reconciliation and renew the allowance to two.

pins.name: FailedAndNoChangeRepairsRetained
pins.says: Failed and no-change repairs can retain their different causes and both consume their authorized attempts.

pins.name: InvalidatedRepairRetainsUsage
pins.says: A repair invalidated by a newer head can settle without publishing stale contents or refunding its attempt.

pins.name: TwoWatchersRecoverFollowup
pins.says: Two watchers can both take part in a follow-up that is merged and settled after the maximum modeled crashes.

pins.name: FollowRunsSettled
pins.says: Every started follow-up agent operation eventually has a durable reconciled outcome under watcher fairness.

pins.name: FollowPublicationsSettled
pins.says: Every dispatched follow-up publication eventually reconciles its durable result without waiting for a person.

pins.name: FollowKnownMergesSettled
pins.says: A confirmed remote merge or definitive merge refusal is eventually settled through the follow-up outcome path.

pins.name: FollowRequestsAnswered
pins.says: Every modeled explicit writer retry or resume is eventually consumed and answered after any unresolved repair is reconciled.

pins.name: FollowAuthorizedWorkStarts
pins.says: Every accepted follow-up operation authorization eventually dispatches its recorded effect or reconciles a superseding remote observation under watcher fairness.

pins.name: DuplicateFollowCreation
pins.says: Recovery misses a closed or merged PR after losing its creation response and creates another.

pins.name: DuplicateFollowRun
pins.says: Recovery restarts the same stopped follow-up operation instead of recording a fresh attempt.

pins.name: DuplicateFollowMerge
pins.says: Recovery performs a second merge after the follow-up PR was already merged.

pins.name: ApplyStaleRepairResult
pins.says: A watcher applies an older operation result to the current repair.

pins.name: DispatchWithoutRecord
pins.says: Recovery starts a follow-up agent effect before recording its intent and snapshot association.

pins.name: FollowEffectAfterLeaseLoss
pins.says: A watcher continues a follow-up effect after losing the repository lease.

pins.name: ReuseFollowCI
pins.says: Recovery reuses CI and mergeability from an older revision after a repair changes the head.

pins.name: ResumeWithoutWriter
pins.says: Recovery renews a closed or exhausted follow-up without an explicit writer request.

pins.name: RenewBeforeReconciliation
pins.says: Recovery consumes a pending writer request before the existing repair and publication are reconciled.

pins.name: TreatAuthorizationAsMerge
pins.says: Recovery treats a persisted merge authorization as proof that GitHub merged the PR.

pins.name: ChargeLostPushAgain
pins.says: Recovery spends a second repair allowance while reconciling a lost publication response.

pins.name: HideRepairFailure
pins.says: Recovery changes a no-change repair result into a generic failure.

pins.name: FollowAutomaticRetries
pins.says: A reconciled failed or stopped draft or failed creation eventually starts a fresh recorded operation automatically under Workflow authorization.

pins.name: LostRepairThenExternalMerge
pins.says: A repair publication whose response is lost can be reconciled after a person merges the PR without another publication or merge.

pins.name: RepairClosedReconciled
pins.says: A person can close a PR during an authorized repair, which settles as invalidated and retains its usage.

pins.name: MergeClosedBeforeDispatch
pins.says: Closure after merge authorization can cancel its dispatch and leave the follow-up on hold.

pins.name: MergeObservedBeforeDispatch
pins.says: An external merge after authorization can settle without dispatching the authorized merge.

pins.name: MergeHeadInvalidated
pins.says: A head change after merge authorization can invalidate that authorization without reusing its CI.

pins.name: RefusedThenExternallyMerged
pins.says: A refused factory merge can later settle through observation of a person merging the PR.

pins.name: FollowUnmergeableReported
pins.says: Passing CI on an unmergeable follow-up can be reported without dispatching a merge.
